newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Heng Fung proposes 1-for-5 bonus warrant.
newsitem.headline: Heng Fung proposes 1-for-5 bonus warrant.

text.p: Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday it proposed to distribute a bonus issue of 131.92 million warrants to shareholders in the proportion of one warrant for every five shares held.

Each warrant carries the rights to subscribe for one company share at HK$0.48 each subject to adjustment and exercisable from May 26, 1997 to May 30, 1998. Application will be made to list the warrants in Hong Kong, the company said in a statement.
The property concern said a total 131.92 new shares, representing 16.7 percent of the enlarged share capital, would be issued on exercise in full of the warrants.
Heng Fung shares edged down one cent to HK$0.59 at midday Friday.
